market_context: Futures are sharply lower before the open, with S&P 500 futures down about 2% and Nasdaq-100 futures down about 3%. The drivers are a hot core PCE of 3.3% against the 3.2% expected, about a 98% chance of a December Fed rate hike, new 20% tariffs and a renewed AI/chip sell-off. Nvidia is down 4-6% premarket after Huang refused to set out succession plans, and Anthropic is trading below its IPO price. VIX is above 31 and the 10-year yield is 4.84%.

predictions.reasoning: Nasdaq-100 futures are down about 3% on the AI sell-off, with Nvidia, Oracle and Anthropic all lower. Hot PCE and a near-certain Fed hike add pressure, so a gap down that holds into the close is likely, with some intraday bounce possible.

S&P 500 futures are down about 2% after a core PCE of 3.3% against the 3.2% expected, a 98% chance of a December rate hike and new 20% tariffs on China, the EU and others. Part of the gap may be recovered ahead of Thanksgiving, so I expect a close about 1.5% lower.

Nvidia is down 4-6% premarket as it gives back the 31% Huang-reinstatement rally. Huang is defying succession-planning calls, there is political scrutiny, and chip stocks are weak, with Ambarella down about 40%.
Dow futures are down about 1.3%, or roughly 635 points, on inflation and tariff worries. The Dow has less tech exposure, so I expect a smaller decline than the S&P 500 or Nasdaq.
